notifications.name: ModulAir
notifications.danger: The product's printed circuit board (PCB) component's inadequate load capacity under certain conditions and the improperly assembled DIN Rail cables lacking ferrules can cause overheating, melting and breakdown. This may generate smoke and fumes. This also presents a risk of burns or fire if contact is made with flammable materials inside the unit. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Pressure Equipment Directive.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): An engineer will visit consumers homes to carry out remedial works.Date of entry into force: 13/03/2024

notifications.name: Proboost

This also presents a risk of fire and burns if flammable materials are stored near the unit. The product does not comply with the requirements of the General Product Safety Directive.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): An engineer will visit consumers homes to carry out remedial works.Date of entry into force: 20/05/2024

notifications.name: Solar gekoppelter Wechselrichter
notifications.danger: The product is insufficiently insulated. The protective conductor ends on the circuit board and is not connected to the metal housing. If the single insulation of the live parts inside the appliance is defective, the entire metal housing can carry mains voltage. The user could consequently touch live parts and receive an electric shock. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 62109-1 and 62109-2.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): OtherCategory of measure(s): Removal of this product listing by the online marketplaceDate of entry into force: 22/02/2025
notifications.description: Solar inverter for converting direct current (DC) from a photovoltaic system to alternating current (AC) to be fed into the mains network. Input voltages from 16 to 28 Volts DC and an output voltage of 180 to 260 Volts. Product sold online, in particular via Amazon (ASIN: B0C9MPG46J).
